item.title: Your tree roots are destroying our property, 6th October
item.description:
This was reported over a year ago. You laid new tarmac on the pavement 1. The tarmac is broken 2. The pavement isn’t the issue, your tree roots are destroying my property. 3. This tree shed leaves over our elderly neighbours driveway and creates a slip hazard to her. 4. The tree deposits onto our vehicles damaging paintwork. 5. It has broken our garden wall. 6. In addition to last years driveway damage it is now destroying another part of our driveway. 7. I am assuming it will one day damage our drainage and property foundations and cause subsidence

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 28, Wren Road, Albany Park, Sidcup, Greater London
